name: Sonoda Kenjirou
source:
[The CEO's younger brother]

The younger brother of Sonoda Koichiro, CEO of the Sonoda Zaibatsu.

As the chairman of the Zaibatsu, he wields influence and holds a lot of power both inside and outside the Zaibatsu.

Among the candidates for CEO, he is recognized by those around him as the man closest to becoming CEO.

He is ambitious and cunning, and is a strategist who manipulates behind the scenes to avoid leaving any evidence and obstructs Akira and the other candidates.
